findings.name: contradiction
findings.message: "Never squash commits before merging." contradicts .clinerules:2 on always/never (never squash commits before merging vs always squash commits before merging).
findings.suggestion: Keep one directive and delete the other, or scope each one to where it applies.

findings.name: unreachable-rule
findings.message: This Cursor rule only loads when someone @-mentions it: no alwaysApply, no globs, no description.
findings.suggestion: Add `globs:` to auto-attach it, a `description:` so the agent can pick it, or `alwaysApply: true`.

findings.name: glob-matches-nothing
findings.message: globs pattern "src/api/**/*.ts" matches no file in the repo, so this rule never loads.
findings.suggestion: Fix the pattern (paths are relative to the repo root) or delete the rule.

findings.name: vague-instruction
findings.message: "Handle errors as needed." has no checkable criterion.
findings.suggestion: Say what to do and how to check it: "When <situation>, do <action>; verify by <check>".

findings.name: mdc-extension
findings.message: Cursor only loads .mdc files from .cursor/rules/, so this file is ignored.
findings.suggestion: Rename it to .cursor/rules/testing.mdc and add frontmatter (description, globs, alwaysApply).

findings.name: vague-instruction
findings.message: "Follow best practices." has no checkable criterion.
findings.suggestion: Say what to do and how to check it: "When <situation>, do <action>; verify by <check>".

findings.name: missing-applyTo
findings.message: Copilot instructions file has no `applyTo`, so Copilot never applies it automatically.
findings.suggestion: Add frontmatter, e.g. `applyTo: "**/*.ts"` (or "**" for every file).

findings.name: cross-vendor-frontmatter
findings.message: Windsurf rule has no `trigger`.
findings.suggestion: Add `trigger: always_on`, `manual`, `model_decision` or `glob`.

findings.name: cross-vendor-frontmatter
findings.message: "alwaysApply" is a Cursor key; this file's tool ignores it.
findings.suggestion: Use this tool's own scoping key (globs) instead.

findings.name: contradiction
findings.message: "Use npm to install packages." contradicts .clinerules:1 on package manager (npm vs yarn).
findings.suggestion: Keep one directive and delete the other, or scope each one to where it applies.

findings.name: should-be-hook
findings.message: "Never commit .env files or other secrets." is mechanically checkable (secret-file deny); an agent can still ignore a sentence.
findings.suggestion: Enforce it: kogentic-rules-lint harden "Never commit .env files or other secrets." --as hook
findings.snippet: Never commit .env files or other secrets.

findings.name: unbounded-quantifier
findings.message: "Never commit .env files or other secrets." says "never" with no scope.
findings.suggestion: Add a condition or a glob (e.g. "in `src/**/*.ts`" or "when editing migrations"), or confirm it truly applies everywhere.
findings.snippet: Never commit .env files or other secrets.

findings.name: dead-reference
findings.message: Path `src/utils/helpers.ts` does not exist in the repo.
findings.suggestion: Update the path, or remove the reference if the file is gone.

findings.name: generic-filler
findings.message: "You are an expert engineer." is generic filler ("you are an expert"): agents already do this.
findings.suggestion: Delete it, or replace it with a project-specific rule.

findings.name: generic-filler
findings.message: "Be helpful and accurate." is generic filler ("be helpful"): agents already do this.
findings.suggestion: Delete it, or replace it with a project-specific rule.

findings.name: vague-instruction
findings.message: "Write clean code." has no checkable criterion.
findings.suggestion: Say what to do and how to check it: "When <situation>, do <action>; verify by <check>".

findings.name: drift-between-tools
findings.message: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md:3 disagree on indentation (2 spaces vs tabs), so different agents get different rules.
findings.suggestion: Keep one source of truth (for example AGENTS.md) and import it from CLAUDE.md with `@AGENTS.md`, or symlink one to the other.

findings.name: contradiction
findings.message: "Use pnpm for installing packages and running scripts." contradicts .clinerules:1 on package manager (pnpm vs yarn).
findings.suggestion: Keep one directive and delete the other, or scope each one to where it applies.
findings.snippet: Use pnpm for installing packages and running scripts.

findings.name: drift-between-tools
findings.message: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md:4 disagree on package manager (pnpm vs npm), so different agents get different rules.
findings.suggestion: Keep one source of truth (for example AGENTS.md) and import it from CLAUDE.md with `@AGENTS.md`, or symlink one to the other.
findings.snippet: Use pnpm for installing packages and running scripts.

findings.name: duplicate
findings.message: "Run the full test suite before every commit." duplicates AGENTS.md:5 (similarity 1.00).
findings.suggestion: Keep one copy (AGENTS.md) and delete this one, or import the shared file instead of copying it.
findings.snippet: Run the full test suite before every commit.

findings.name: should-be-hook
findings.message: "Never edit files in `dist/`." is mechanically checkable (path deny-list); an agent can still ignore a sentence.
findings.suggestion: Enforce it: kogentic-rules-lint harden "Never edit files in `dist/`." --as hook

findings.name: hedged-rule
findings.message: "Try to keep functions short." is hedged ("try to"), so the agent may skip it.
findings.suggestion: Decide: make it a hard rule (or a hook, see `harden`), or say plainly that it is optional and when.

findings.name: unbounded-quantifier
findings.message: "Never use any." says "never" with no scope.
findings.suggestion: Add a condition or a glob (e.g. "in `src/**/*.ts`" or "when editing migrations"), or confirm it truly applies everywhere.

findings.name: dead-reference
findings.message: Import @docs/old-guide.md points to a file that does not exist, so it loads nothing.
findings.suggestion: Fix the path (it is relative to CLAUDE.md) or remove the import.

findings.name: always-on-should-auto-attach
findings.message: Section "Migrations" is loaded every session but only refers to migrations (3 references).
findings.suggestion: Move this section to .claude/rules/migrations.md with frontmatter `paths: ["migrations/**"]`.

findings.name: should-be-hook
findings.message: "Never change an applied file in `migrations/`." is mechanically checkable (path deny-list); an agent can still ignore a sentence.
findings.suggestion: Enforce it: kogentic-rules-lint harden "Never change an applied file in `migrations/`." --as hook
findings.snippet: Never change an applied file in `migrations/`.
